nodes.name: Wake Dispatcher
nodes.notes: Wakes the Outbox Dispatcher so alerts go out now instead of on the next 1-minute tick. Failure is harmless (the 1-minute schedule still runs). On n8n Cloud, set the Variable RFE_INTERNAL_URL to your instance URL if your plan has Variables.
